findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body: When an authenticated caller supplies another tenant's document ID, `getDocument` now omits `ctx.tenantId` and `loadDocument` queries only by `{ documentId }`. In a shared database this can return another tenant's document. Preserve the tenant ID in the lookup criteria.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body:
`getDocument` no longer constrains queries by `ctx.tenantId`. If another tenant owns the requested `documentId`, `db.find` can return that tenant’s document, causing cross-tenant data disclosure. This also breaks direct callers of the previous three-argument `loadDocument` API.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported cache module
findings.body:
Deleting `src/cache.ts` removes the exported `readCached` API. Existing consumers or tests importing this module will fail module resolution at compile time or runtime.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body:
In a shared database, a caller authenticated to tenant A can supply tenant B’s document ID; the lookup now ignores `ctx.tenantId` and returns any matching document, causing cross-tenant data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
